description: Live THORChain quote for swapping XRP to BTC, ETH or USDC: expected amount out, every fee (ours is 0.5%), minimum size and expiry. Screens the destination against the OFAC list. Read-only; builds nothing.

amount_xrp.description: XRP to send, e.g. "20" (up to 6 decimals). Must be at least the quote's minimum_xrp.

destination.description: Address that receives the coins: a Bitcoin address for BTC, an Ethereum 0x address for ETH or USDC.

to.description: What to receive: BTC (Bitcoin), ETH (Ether) or USDC (USDC on Ethereum).

name: quote_swap
title: Quote an XRP swap
